stock.description: Established in 2012 and based in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China, GL-Carlink Technology Holding Limited serves the automotive aftermarket throughout its home country. The company's core business involves the wholesale and retail provision of various in-vehicle hardware products. This range includes advanced infotainment systems, such as smart GPS navigators and central control displays, alongside crucial safety systems like intelligent dash cameras, smart rear-view mirrors, and their related modules. Additionally, it supplies core boards. Beyond physical products, GL-Carlink offers software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions for marketing and management, covering both subscription models and enhanced value-added features. Its clientele is broad, encompassing 4S dealership networks, various channel partners, automotive financing and leasing firms, and original equipment manufacturers of in-vehicle devices.
